claims.claim: Force-directed and manual layouts assign drawing coordinates; Euclidean display distances are not necessarily measured geographic or graph distances.

claims.claim: A classical Fruchterman–Reingold model uses attractive and repulsive force magnitudes scaled by d²/k and k²/d respectively.
